story: Rosa and Ali are at a beautiful river. They remember their trip to see an elephant. Now, they share one big bed in a small house.
title: A Trip to the River
setting: A small wooden house near a large river.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: a man with short black hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Rosa and Ali sit by the river.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a woman with long brown hair and a green shirt, and Ali, a man with short black hair and a blue shirt, sit by a large blue river.

sentences.en: They remember a very large elephant.
sentences.zh: 他们记得一只非常大的大象。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa and Ali look at a picture of a large grey elephant.

sentences.en: They saw the elephant during their trip.
sentences.zh: 他们在旅行期间看到了那只大象。
sentences.scene_prompt: A large grey elephant walks near Rosa and Ali in a green field.

sentences.en: They stay in the same small house.
sentences.zh: 他们住在同一个小房子里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa and Ali stand in front of a small wooden house.

sentences.en: They share one very big bed.
sentences.zh: 他们共用一张非常大的床。
sentences.scene_prompt: A large comfortable bed is inside the small wooden house.

sentences.en: Ali is the kind husband of Rosa.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali smiles at Rosa inside the small wooden house.
